name: Il Mondo Bene Essere
summary:
Il Mondo Bene Essere brings together the VR exercises created by the Bene Essere team in Rome in a single immersive island.

HOW IT WORKS
- A 3D island floats in front of you: rotate it with the controller or the thumbstick and point at a place.
- Each place opens its exercises. Before starting you see a short description and can adjust the settings (difficulty, duration, speed and more) directly in VR.
- Each exercise runs in full immersion and brings you back to the island when you finish.
